seo.title: Talk to an Independent Advisor
seo.description: Send us a note or call 1300 277 228. A short, no-pressure conversation about your home, your timeline and what matters most — with no obligation to go any further.

data.heading: Tell us where you are up to —
data.headingEm: we will take it from there.
data.intro: Leave your details and an advisor will call you back, usually within one business day. Nothing is committed to on that call: most people ring us long before they are ready to sell, which is the right time to ask. Prefer to talk now? Call 1300 277 228.
data.consent: I agree to be contacted about this enquiry.
data.confirmation: Thank you — we have your enquiry, and an advisor will be in touch within one business day. If it is urgent, please ring 1300 277 228.
